48.original: I hope she's all right... Oh, I want to go after her, but what if she comes back while I'm away?

49.original: Hm? You must be a familiar. Can you help me deliver a message?

50.original: I have an associate who works much too hard. I want to tell her to take a break and join me for a nice, relaxing meal.

51.original: I sent another familiar already, but it's failed to return... As an experimental entity, it is too simple to handle more than one order at a time, so it might be stuck attempting to fulfill my request.

52.original: Would you mind checking on them both for me? I can give you a little something if you're willing help out...?

53.original: Wonderful. Knowing my associate, she's probably dozing off somewhere around the trees to the north. This wouldn't happen if she'd get a good night's rest for once...

54.original: You might need to give her a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>poke<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to wake her up.

55.original: If my associate is nodding off, try giving her a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>poke<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to wake her up.

56.original: The observer is fast asleep, completely unresponsive to the familiar fussing over her. A good <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>poke<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> might wake her up.

58.original: Epiphron sent you? Just to invite me to eat? Why send a familiar for something so trivial?

59.original: Although, come to think of it, I <hex:021A020203>could<hex:021A020103> use a meal. Please let him know I'll be along soon.

60.original: ...Wait, are you a familiar as well? I thought you were one of us for a moment! Anyway, thank you for waking me.

61.original: I suppose we'll be eating at our usual place. A nice cup of tea to start with sounds lovely... Well? Do you not also need to report to Epiphron?

62.original: Thank you for your help. My familiar says my associate has accepted my invitation. That is what happened, yes?

63.original: Good. That means it can carry out its duties on a basic level, at least.

64.original: I designed it to convey ideas through information-laden aether rather than words, so I'm happy to see the communication was successful.

65.original: It does seem, however, that this method is ineffective when the recipient of the message is asleep... I'll get to work on fixing that.

66.original: But not now. Enjoying some time with my associate is the priority at the moment. Thank you again for your help.
